items.jbi_rule: Original Research Paper / Methodological Informatics Research.
items.evidence: Paper presents a novel informatics synthesis methodology and governance framework.

items.jbi_rule: Structured abstract with Background, Problem, Method, Results, Conclusion / Limitations (max ~300 words).
items.evidence: Abstract contains structured sections: Background, Problem, Method, Experimental Demonstration, Main Results, Limitations & Contribution (248 words).

items.jbi_rule: 3 to 5 bullet points, each <= 85 characters including spaces.
items.evidence: 5 bullet points generated in jbi_highlights.md, all strictly <= 85 characters.
8 standard MeSH terms defined in submission metadata.
Manuscript contains 3,987 words, concise, focused, and well within limits.

items.jbi_rule: High-resolution (300+ DPI), clearly labeled with uncropped captions.
items.evidence: 8 figures generated in 300 DPI PNG and vector SVG under evidence/final/submission/figures/.

items.jbi_rule: Editable structured tables with descriptive captions.
items.evidence: Tables 1, 2, and 3 embedded in PDF with clean cell borders and headers.

items.jbi_rule: Numbered Vancouver / NLM citation format with PMIDs/DOIs.
items.evidence: All 4 literature references contain verified PMIDs and provenance trails.

items.jbi_rule: Mandatory statement explaining repository or open data access.
items.evidence: Statement references open-source HANCOCK benchmark and repo split files.

items.jbi_rule: Mandatory statement with open-source software URL and reproducibility details.
items.evidence: Code availability statement included with open-source MIT license details.

items.jbi_rule: Declaration regarding institutional ethics approval / exemption for clinical data.
items.evidence: De-identified retrospective secondary data exemption statement included.

items.jbi_rule: Elsevier mandatory author contribution statement using CRediT taxonomy.
items.evidence: credit_statement.md generated; authors must replace placeholder initials with actual names before portal submission.

items.jbi_rule: Real author names, ORCIDs, and departmental addresses required in portal.
items.evidence: submission_metadata.json contains standardized placeholders (AUTHOR_NAME_PLACEHOLDER) to protect blinding and prevent fabrication; authors must input actual co-author names during portal upload.

items.jbi_rule: Mandatory COI statement in manuscript and portal declaration.
items.evidence: Standardized non-competing financial interest statement provided.

items.jbi_rule: Detailed cover letter addressing Editor-in-Chief without promotional hype.
items.evidence: cover_letter.md accurately summarizes methodology, conservative empirical margin (+0.0047), Seed 100 loss, and absence of clinical deployment claims.
